name: Plinth
description: A sleek dark changelog: dates in the gutter, illustrated release notes, tag filters and a one-line email subscribe.
features: Zero custom CSS — every detail is a theme setting

posts.title: Stacked branches
posts.markdown:
![A stack of dependent branches](/api/assets/00000000-0000-4000-8000-0000000000a1)

Stacked branches now appear as one row in the review queue. Step through the stack and see review, checks and merge state for each branch at a glance.

- Rebase the whole stack in one action.
- Merge from the bottom up, automatically.

Placeholder release notes.
